verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name DDL plus explicit event, rule version, alert case, model observation, taxonomy, identity, history, restricted payload and decision-authority boundaries.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with exact tenant, source event, rule/policy version, invocation/model version, subject identity, alert/clue/review/decision lineage, deletion history and independently accepted effects.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Raw observations, alerts, model results, clues, reviews and decisions append; rules and event-level taxonomies publish immutable effective-dated versions.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Source deletion or invalidation retires a projection but never erases alert, model, review, decision or accepted-effect audit history.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, source system/event, Principal/subject, policy/rule version, model/invocation, alert/clue and owning-domain decision; quarantine raw JSON, ambiguous aliases, unversioned scores and unsupported effects.
